scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/app.config.ts apps/mobile/app.json apps/mobile/eas.json apps/mobile/eslint.config.js apps/mobile/package.json apps/mobile/tsconfig.json packages/domain/src packages/domain/package.json packages/domain/tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.validate:expo: pnpm --filter mobile exec expo install --check && pnpm --filter mobile exec pnpm dlx expo-doctor@1.20.3
